name: Man Wearing Braid
overview: Scripture addresses the appearance and grooming of men, emphasizing distinctions between genders and holy conduct. Leviticus instructs against altering the edges of the head and beard, while Deuteronomy forbids men from wearing women's garments, marking such acts as abominations before God. Ezekiel further commands that priests neither shave their heads nor let their hair grow long, but only trim it, illustrating a call for modesty and order. Paul's example in Acts, shaving his head in fulfillment of a vow, demonstrates that grooming practices can carry spiritual significance, all within the broader biblical call to present our bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God.
